_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: rocket $39 and sleeper $3A ($BBF9-$BDBB). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): flying already?
regions.description: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): An initialised object in state 4 or more skips the scroll and runs the flight code (`$BCD8`). Table stats: collision flags `$5A` (Eraser-immune, big burst), hit points 32, attack 64, drawing flags `$13`, dies as type 8. A ground object made from the stage's metatiles; **no area scaling**.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): ride the scroll
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): first frame?
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): stats, picture, state
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): state 0: wait for y > `$30`
regions.description: The step timer is 16 frames (4 when `$B9` is 2 or more); `LDA #$30 / JSR $BBEC` (past y 48: the timer `$07A0` := the step, state 1); not yet: return.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): state 0 -> 1: remember the step, draw the first row
regions.description: `$07D0` := `$07A0`; the PPU address moves one tile left (`$BBA3`); a 4 x 1 row of tiles (`$BD19`: `B0 B1 B2 B3`) is blitted. RUN: queue item `04 21 1F B0 B1 B2 B3` (4 tiles at PPU `$211F`).

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): state 1: the top row too
regions.description: In state 1 only, a second row (`$BD25`: `BC BD BE BF`) is blitted.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): states 1-3: the step timer
regions.description: `$07A0` is decremented; at zero it is reloaded from `$07D0`, the state is incremented and, unless the state was 3 (the launch, `$BCB2`), the PPU address moves up a row (`$BBA3`) and the row `B0 B1 B2 B3` is drawn again - **a 4-wide column builds up a row at a time, every 16 frames (every 4 at speed 2)**. RUN: rows at PPU `$211F`, `$20FF`, `$20DF`, then a row `80 81 80 81` (floor tiles) at `$20DF`.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): not hittable before state 3
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): states 3 and over: hit test
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): destroyed: blast and erase
regions.description: The type becomes `$30` (the block blast) and the 4 x 4 block is erased (`$BCEA`).

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): return
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): state 3 -> launch
regions.description: Anything but exactly state 3 goes to the flight code.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): launch: erase the structure
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): launch: the sprite
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): launch: direction
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF` (the direction to the player) and `$C102` with `$BD09[direction]`: `0F 0E 0D 0D 0C 0B 0B 0A 09 0A 0B 0B 0C 0D 0E 0E`, i.e. **a direction folded so that it always points upward and toward the player's side**.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): launch: gravity target
TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): flight: gravity
regions.description: `LDA #$08 / JSR $C09C`: the y spring pulls 8/256 a frame toward the bottom.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): flight: tile
regions.description: While rising the tile base `$71`; once falling (y speed non-negative) `$75`.

regions.name: TYPE $39 (A ROCKET THAT BUILDS ITSELF ON THE GROUND AND TAKES OFF): flight: move, hit, resolve
regions.description: `JMP $9F4F`: an ordinary enemy now. RUN: launched at frame 86 and flew a gravity arc until it hit the player's position.

regions.name: Helper: erase a 4 x 4 cell (`$BCEA`)
regions.description: `JSR $BF71`; width = height = 4; the block `$BD29` (`80 81 80 81 / 81 80 81 80 ...`, the floor checker) is blitted at y - 16 (at least 0).

regions.name: Type $39 launch direction by aim
regions.description: `0F 0E 0D 0D 0C 0B 0B 0A 09 0A 0B 0B 0C 0D 0E 0E`: the aim (0-15) folded to an upward direction.

regions.name: Type $39 tile rows
regions.description: `B0 B1 B2 B3 / B4 B5 B6 B7 / B8 B9 BA BB / BC BD BE BF`: only the first row (`$BD19`) and the last (`$BD25`) are drawn by the traced code.

regions.description: TYPE $3A (A SLEEPER THAT WAKES WHEN THE PLAYER IS BELOW): A type with bit 7 set and a state other than 0 goes straight to the shooting (`$BD8C`). Table stats: collision flags `$5A`, hit points 16, attack 32 (no area scaling), drawing flags `$1B`, dies as type 8. A ground object made from stage metatiles.

regions.description: `JSR $C0AE`; x += 8, y += 8 (the cell centre); tile base `$61`; metasprite `$8C`; state 0.

regions.description: `LDY #$08 / JSR $BBEC`: when the object's y is past that line - i.e. the player is less than about 96 px below it - the timer becomes 8 and the state 1.

regions.description: `JSR $BCEA`: the 4 x 4 cell is overwritten with floor (RUN: queue item `04 21 20 80 81 80 81`).
